completed_finding: Two finite original pure-effect RMEA heads encode the same labels on a predetermined two-point head-input distribution. Both attention transplants harm the fixed recipient, while a fixed decoder sign change recovers identical logits. Thus mutual transplant harm does not imply lost task information.
limits: Synthetic head-input boundary, not observed Re-TACRED/RoBERTa behavior or a full-function equivalence.
Known coadaptation and readout factorization; no accepted theorem novelty, utility gain, phase necessity or universal classical separation.
The actual encoder inserts ordered subject/object punctuation: the uniform baseline may contain entity information in its contextual features.

The finite unclipped common-context rank restriction of affine role softmax is conditional. Total mass, clipping, changed encoder inputs and nonlinear classical controls prevent an overall classification impossibility claim.
Static/dynamic attention is established prior work; one rank reversal is weaker than a universally dynamic family guarantee.
conditional_followup: A train-only readout comparison must use separate evaluation inputs and account for optimizer/regularization differences; same-sample high-dimensional interpolation is not information evidence.

next_seed.mechanism: Entity-anchored ordered commutator / cyclic triple-overlap attention
